name: taxreturn
title: Tax Return
description: An accountant's theme drawn as a paper tax return: a teal-tinted ground, every service a heavily numbered box with its guidance note in small print, and each fee entered in a white box in ballpoint-blue typewriter figures.

tokens.--font-sans: all printed text: titles, captions, guidance notes — the plain grotesque of an official form
tokens.--font-number: the heavy number on every service box
tokens.--font-mono: anything entered on the form: fees, names, dates, phone and e-mail, and code in page text
tokens.--text-note: size of the small print: guidance notes, credentials, the labels beside entry boxes, the footer
tokens.--weight-heavy: weight of the site title, page titles and section headings
tokens.--color-bg: the tinted paper of the form — the page background
tokens.--color-text: the form's print: titles, captions, notes, box numbers and heavy rules
tokens.--color-muted: the quieter print: the footer and the page counter under a list
tokens.--color-accent: links in running text and the quote rule
tokens.--color-box: entry boxes: fee boxes, name boxes, the tick boxes of the menu, table cells
tokens.--color-entry: ballpoint ink: everything written in a box, and the crosses in tick boxes
tokens.--color-band: the solid heading band above a block of boxes, and the first-meeting panel
tokens.--color-band-ink: text on the band and the panel
tokens.--color-line: the comb of ticks along the foot of every entry box, and the thin rules between service boxes, between news items and between the rows of the office hours
tokens.--color-shade: a darker tint of the paper: the caption strip of each section heading in page text, and behind code
tokens.--measure: width of the single column on tablets and of a page with nothing beside it
tokens.--col-notes: share of the width given to the left column of titles and notes on a wide screen
tokens.--col-form: share of the width given to the right column of boxes or text on a wide screen
tokens.--box-width: width of the fee box at the right of each service and of the date box beside each news item
tokens.--cell: width of one character cell in an entry box — every entered character sits between two ticks of the comb
tokens.--number-width: room kept at the left of each service for its box number
tokens.--tick: size of a tick box in the menu and in the list of what a service includes
tokens.--rule-heavy: weight of the heavy rules under the masthead, above lists and beside quotes
tokens.--rule-thin: weight of the thin rules between boxes
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of boxes and bands — a form's corners are nearly square
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page on a phone
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a caption and its note, under a label
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside boxes and bands
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and inside a row of the list
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: between the two columns and above the footer
